common.title: Platform Config
common.description: Manage platform service endpoints, website branding, object storage, and other runtime configurations

url.title: Endpoint Config
url.description: Manage access URLs for each client
url.adminBaseUrlDesc: Base URL of the admin portal. Used to generate callback URLs when third-party login client=admin
url.merchantBaseUrlDesc: Merchant portal origin. Used for client=merchant OAuth callbacks (/auth/oauth-callback/{source} and bind path). Must match the merchant frontend origin and be whitelisted in the OAuth console
url.paymentGatewayBaseUrlDesc: Access URL of the payment gateway page, used for payment page redirection
url.backendBaseUrlDesc: Base API URL of the backend service, used for backend-initiated scenarios like payment callback notifications
url.inputPaymentGatewayBaseUrl: Enter payment gateway URL, e.g. https://pay.daxpay.com
url.inputBackendBaseUrl: Enter backend API URL, e.g. https://api.daxpay.com
url.confirmSaveContent: Are you sure to save endpoint configuration?

website.title: Website Config
website.description: Manage system name, logo, filing and copyright display settings
website.systemNameDesc: Displayed on the login page and browser title
website.companyNameDesc: Full legal name of the operating company
website.companyWechatDesc: Public support or sales WeChat ID (not payment channel config)
website.logoDesc: Used on login page, sidebar and favicon. SVG recommended, height 40-80px
website.logoDarkDesc: For dark theme. Falls back to light logo if empty. SVG recommended
website.icpLinkDesc: URL opened when clicking ICP filing text
website.mpsInfoDesc: e.g. Beijing Public Security Filing No. xxxxxxxx
website.mpsLinkDesc: URL opened when clicking public security filing text
website.pcacInfoDesc: Payment & Clearing Association of China filing text
website.pcacLinkDesc: URL opened when clicking PCAC filing text
website.icpPlusLinkDesc: URL opened when clicking the license text
website.copyrightDesc: Company/brand text shown next to Copyright in the footer
website.confirmSaveContent: Are you sure to save website configuration?
website.linkMustHttp: Link must start with http:// or https://

oss.title: OSS Config
oss.confirmSaveContent: Are you sure you want to save OSS configuration?
oss.regionDesc: Data center region where storage service is located
oss.publicBucketDesc: Store files that can be accessed publicly
oss.privateBucketDesc: Store private files that require authorization
oss.publicBaseUrlDesc: External access address for public bucket files
oss.privateBaseUrlDesc: Base address for private bucket presigned URLs
oss.pathStyleAccessDesc: Enable for path style, disable for virtual host style
oss.inputUploadExpireMinutes: Please enter upload presigned URL expiration (minutes)
oss.inputDownloadExpireHours: Please enter download/view presigned URL expiration (hours)
oss.uploadExpireMinutesDesc: Presigned URL validity duration for frontend file uploads, unit: minutes
oss.downloadExpireHoursDesc: Presigned URL validity duration for file download or view, unit: hours
oss.basePathDesc: Path prefix for file storage, e.g., platform, final path: platform/2026/04/10/xxx.jpg
